title: Frozen-V1 CI gate under-enforces its own stated guarantee (2 instances)
description: Instance 1 (100-113): on a host without GNU sha256sum the hash verification is skipped with `status` UNTOUCHED, so an EDITED frozen V1 passes green with only a note on stderr. Instance 2 (118-145): the script never reads a commit message (exit $status is unconditional), so the GOLDEN-RULE-OVERRIDE it names as the only deliberate way past the gate is UNIMPLEMENTED in this layer; and editing a frozen file while regenerating FROZEN.sha256 in the SAME commit satisfies every check, because manifest_count != 2 rejects only an emptied or extended manifest, never a re-pinned one.
impact: None on chain; a process control over src/versions/**. CI (ubuntu-latest) is currently intact; the exposure is the local / pre-commit path the story itself directs developers to.
recommendation: Either make the CI gate honour a GOLDEN-RULE-OVERRIDE commit-message marker, or rewrite the banner to say what is true. Cheap structural fix: add src/versions/v1/FROZEN.sha256 to a CODEOWNERS / required-review path. Also set status on the sha256sum-absent branch.
overlaps: c8218865da (open, qa) - leg 2's first half (the same false enforcement claim, restated in the script banner rather than in CLAUDE.md). RECONCILE against it, do not double-file. The sha256sum-absent skip and the same-commit re-pin bypass are genuinely NEW.
adjacent: 9abbb7b146 (ss14l3, open, low) - gate fails to prevent DELETION. Distinct mechanism, not merged.
disclosureAuthority: CLAUDE.md's disclosed 'Known gap' (N7) is scoped to enforcement LAYER 2 (the PreToolUse hook) and does not reach LAYER 3 (this CI script), of which the same document claims 'no blind spot'. The disclosure does not suppress this.
dependencyNote: This gate is the SOLE enforcement of the invariant 'V1 must never gain a STAKER_VERSION getter' that parked MR-15-03 depends on.
